strongest_verified_result: For a normal finite-type complex algebraic klt surface and finite effective Cartier divisor family with nonnegative finite integrated weights, I(F)=ord_F(B)<=K0*A_S(F) for all prime divisors over S, and Kopt=1/lct(S;B), with Kopt=0 for B=0. The threshold and reciprocal supremum are attained on a finite log resolution for B!=0.

actionable_findings.issue: Ordinary discrepancies of a klt surface are not necessarily positive; Du Val crepant exceptional divisors have ordinary discrepancy zero.
actionable_findings.repair: Replace 'all discrepancies of the klt surface are positive' by 'the relevant log discrepancies A_S(E) are positive' and optionally display the finite minimum A_S(E)/ord_E(D_j), including strict transforms.

optional_scope_precision: For a standalone abstract assertion, say normal finite-type complex algebraic klt surface. Arbitrary noncompact analytic surfaces can have globally unbounded Cartier multiplicities and threshold zero.
